episode_summary: In this episode, Chris Linsell discusses the transformative impact of AI on the real estate industry, emphasizing the importance of relationship building for agents. The conversation also covers the future of Zillow and independent brokerages, as well as the role of social media in personal branding. Chris provides actionable insights for agents to remain relevant and succeed in a tech-driven market.
